# careeronestop.org API

Search the CareerOneStop Scholarship Finder (10,000+ scholarships, fellowships, grants, prizes and loans) by keyword, level of study, award type, residence and study location, required affiliation and sex, and retrieve full detail (amount, deadline, qualifications, contact, website) for a single award.

## Install / import

```python
from parse_apis.careeronestop_org_api import CareerOneStop
```

## Operations

Call these on the client's collection accessors (e.g. `client.<collection>.<op>(…)`) or via active-record navigation on returned objects — see [`example.py`](./example.py) for the exact call spelling. List operations return a lazy `Paginator`.

| Call | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scholarship.refresh()` | `Scholarship` | Returns the full record for one award identified by scholarship_id from search_scholarships.scholarships[*].scholarship_id: name, organization and address, phone, emails, levels of study, award types, purpose, focus, qualifications (eligibility), selection criteria, award amount, number of awards, duration, how to apply, deadline (as written by the sponsor, e.g. a month and day), and the sponsor's website. Fields the sponsor did not supply are null (or an empty array for list fields). An unknown scholarship_id yields a stale_input / input_not_found error. One round trip per call. |
| `client.scholarships.get(scholarship_id: str)` | `Scholarship` | Returns the full record for one award identified by scholarship_id from search_scholarships.scholarships[*].scholarship_id: name, organization and address, phone, emails, levels of study, award types, purpose, focus, qualifications (eligibility), selection criteria, award amount, number of awards, duration, how to apply, deadline (as written by the sponsor, e.g. a month and day), and the sponsor's website. Fields the sponsor did not supply are null (or an empty array for list fields). An unknown scholarship_id yields a stale_input / input_not_found error. One round trip per call. |
| `scholarshipsummary.details()` | `Scholarship` | Returns the full record for one award identified by scholarship_id from search_scholarships.scholarships[*].scholarship_id: name, organization and address, phone, emails, levels of study, award types, purpose, focus, qualifications (eligibility), selection criteria, award amount, number of awards, duration, how to apply, deadline (as written by the sponsor, e.g. a month and day), and the sponsor's website. Fields the sponsor did not supply are null (or an empty array for list fields). An unknown scholarship_id yields a stale_input / input_not_found error. One round trip per call. |
| `client.scholarship_summaries.search(affiliation: Optional[Affiliation \| Literal['veteran', 'disabled', 'military', 'minority', 'university', 'asian_american', 'native_american', 'african_american', 'hispanic_american', 'union_affiliation', 'employer_affiliation', 'accredited_university', 'religious_affiliation', 'association_membership', 'ethnic_group_membership', 'fraternal_organization_membership']] = None, award_type: Optional[AwardType \| Literal['loan', 'grant', 'prize', 'fellowship', 'scholarship', 'public_grant']] = None, keyword: Optional[str] = None, level_of_study: Optional[LevelOfStudy \| Literal['graduate', 'associate', 'bachelors', 'vocational', 'high_school', 'professional_development']] = None, page_size: Optional[int] = None, residence_location: Optional[str] = None, sex: Optional[Sex \| Literal['male', 'female']] = None, sort: Optional[Sort \| Literal['name_asc', 'name_desc', 'amount_asc', 'amount_desc', 'deadline_asc', 'deadline_desc']] = None, study_location: Optional[str] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, max_fetches: int = 1000)` | `Paginator[ScholarshipSummary]` | Searches the scholarship catalog and returns one page of award summaries (name, organization, purpose, levels of study, award types, award amount, deadline month, canonical scholarship_id and detail URL). All filters combine with AND. Results are paged: page (1-based, default 1) and page_size (10, 25 or 50; default 10) are the caller's paging controls; total is the site's reported match count (the unfiltered catalog reports a maximum of 10,000) and has_more tells whether a further page exists. A combination of filters that matches nothing returns total 0 and an empty scholarships array (success). One round trip per call. Pagination is handled by the returned iterator; page/cursor parameters are not exposed. |

## Errors

| Error | Raised when | Carries |
|---|---|---|
| `InputFormatInvalid` | A parameter value has an invalid format | — |
| `ScholarshipNotFound` | The requested scholarship_id does not match any known award | `scholarship_id` |

Runtime errors (`RateLimitError`, `UpstreamError`, `PaginationLimitError`, …) are importable from `parse_apis` and can occur on any call.

> **Note.** Some params accept an enum whose corresponding output field is raw `str`/`list` (the wire value isn't bound to the enum). Enum members never compare equal to raw strings — compare such output values against `member.value`, or use plain string literals.
